name: restruct/silverstripe-newsgrid
description: News items managed in a grid on a News section page instead of the CMS site tree, with a paginated news list on the site (Silverstripe 5 and 6)

suggest.restruct/silverstripe-filterablearchive: Let readers filter newsitems by date, tag or category
suggest.restruct/silverstripe-softscheduler: Schedule newsitems for automatic publication/expiry on specified dates
suggest.restruct/silverstripe-blockbase: Adds the BlockNewsItems block (recent news items), declared only when blockbase ^2 is installed
